title: Stale SIN-EXEMPT:P029 event handler marker
description: Repeated SIN-EXEMPT:P029 'pending try/catch wrap' markers indicate unclosed hardening work in event handlers and recurring runtime fragility.
detection_method: Regex scan for stale handler pending try/catch exemption marker.
remediation: Wrap handler bodies with try/catch, add Write-AppLog context, then remove stale exemption marker.
examples:
# Bad
$btn.Add_Click({ ... })  # SIN-EXEMPT:P029 -- handler pending try/catch wrap
